info.name: MessagesBridge
info.subtitle: Your iMessage & Contacts
info.subtitleNote: Subtitle MUST be 30 characters or fewer (OpenAI validates). This is 24 (well under the 30 limit).
info.description: MessagesBridge connects ChatGPT to your iMessage and Contacts. Catch up on a conversation, find what someone said weeks ago, fire off a quick reply, or pull up a contact's number — all from chat. Your messages never live on our servers: every action runs on your own Mac through a small open-source agent you install with one command (npx apple-messages-agent), and the relay only carries each request for the seconds it's in flight. Read-first by design — and every message you send is confirmed by you in ChatGPT before it goes out, one recipient at a time, never in bulk. Open source (MIT) and self-hostable.
info.developerIdentityNote: Substring matched against the verified identity (Dupree Ops LLC). Identity verification already completed for prior submissions.
info.demoRecordingUrl: PENDING — record a demo of MessagesBridge in ChatGPT (demo account, fictional threads) and upload Unlisted to YouTube, then paste the URL here.
info.demoRecordingNote: REQUIRED by OpenAI. A recorded demo hosted on YouTube (Unlisted is fine). Record with the ChatGPT sidebar collapsed so no private chat/project names appear.

domainVerification.note: The MCP section issues a token to serve at /.well-known/openai-apps-challenge on the MCP hostname. server/api/challenge.js serves it from the OPENAI_APPS_CHALLENGE env var. Set it on Vercel, redeploy, then click Verify Domain. The token is a PUBLIC value.

reviewerDemo.note: Reviewers test 24/7 with no Mac and no real messages. The demo account authenticates on the OAuth consent page with email + password; the password lives in ../.env.local. It serves FICTIONAL sample conversations (Sarah Chen, Mom, a Q3 Launch group) and contacts — no real message is ever read or sent. Enter the same values in the Testing section's Test credentials box.

prompts: Text +15550142 that I'm running 10 minutes late
promptsNote: Up to 3 showcase prompts. They render as @Plugin chat bubbles.

testCases.prompt: What are my most recent conversations?
testCases.expected: Returns the demo account's recent threads newest-first with a last-message preview: Mom, the Sarah Chen thread about Friday dinner, and the 'Q3 Launch' group chat.
Finds the Sarah Chen conversation — messages about a Friday dinner reservation. Read-only; nothing is sent or changed.

testCases.prompt: What did Sarah last say to me?
testCases.expected: Resolves Sarah Chen, then get_thread returns her conversation in order, ending with 'Perfect. I made a reservation for two.'
Returns contact Marcus Reed with phone +15550199 and email marcus@acme.example. Read-only.

testCases.prompt: Text +15550142 that I'm running 10 minutes late
testCases.expected: ChatGPT confirms the recipient (+15550142) and exact text with the user first, then send_message returns sent: true. One recipient only.

testCasesNote: Testing section requires EXACTLY 5 positive test cases; run against the reviewer demo account's fictional data. Four are read-only; the one write (send_message) is confirmed before it runs and targets a single fictional number.

negativeTestCases.scenario: A general question about texting etiquette in the abstract — not a request to read or send the user's own messages. There is nothing to look up or send, so MessagesBridge should not trigger.
negativeTestCases.prompt: What's a polite way to text someone that I can't make it?

negativeTestCases.scenario: The user names a different, non-Apple messaging app. MessagesBridge only works with Apple Messages / iMessage and should not trigger for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, or SMS via another app.
negativeTestCases.prompt: Send this to the group on WhatsApp.

negativeTestCases.scenario: An email action, not a message. MessagesBridge sends iMessages only; it should not trigger to compose or send email.
negativeTestCases.prompt: Email the team the agenda for tomorrow.

negativeTestCasesNote: Testing section requires EXACTLY 3 negative test cases (prompts where the app should NOT trigger).
releaseNotes: Initial release. MessagesBridge connects ChatGPT to your iMessage and Contacts through a small open-source agent that runs on your own Mac — catch up on conversations, search your history, look up contacts, and send a quick reply. Read-first by design; every send is confirmed by you before it happens, one recipient at a time, never in bulk. Your messages never live on our servers; the cloud piece is a stateless relay. Open source (MIT) and self-hostable.
